name: CELECOXIB 200 MG 10 CAPSULES
description: Celecoxib is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain, inflammation, and stiffness caused by conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis. It is also used to relieve pain and inflammation in other situations, such as injuries or surgeries. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
